subject: general
question: ________ describe(s) India as a secular state.
solution:
Correct answer is __**The Preamble of the Constitution.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Preamble ****of the constitution** establishes India as a Secular State. 
 
• The meaning of a secular state is that **it does not prioritize any one religion for the country and its people**.
 
• The word** 'Secular'** was attached by the Constitution **Act, 1976.**
 
• India is known as a secular state because **it does not have any state religion and people are free to practice any religion of their choice**. ** **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy **motive to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can **guide a good life.**
 
• Article 44 of the constitution looks for the** Indian state to apply directive principles and common law for all Indian citizens while formulating national policies.**
 
• Article 475, delivery to commanding officers of persons liable to be tried by Court-martial.**​ **
